info.name: Postmark Account Activate Messages > Outbound > Opens API

params.name: count
params.description: Number of bounces to return per request. Max 500.

params.name: recipient
params.description: Filter by the user who was receiving the email

params.name: client_name
params.description: Filter by client name, i.e. Outlook, Gmail

params.name: client_company
params.description: Filter by company, i.e. Microsoft, Apple, Google

params.name: client_family
params.description: Filter by client family, i.e. OS X, Chrome

params.name: os_name
params.description: Filter by full OS name and specific version, i.e. OS X 10.9 Mavericks, Windows 7

params.name: os_family
params.description: Filter by kind of OS used without specific version, i.e. OS X, Windows

params.name: os_company
params.description: Filter by company which produced the OS, i.e. Apple Computer, Inc., Microsoft Corporation

params.name: platform
params.description: Filter by platform, i.e. webmail, desktop, mobile

params.name: country
params.description: Filter by country messages were opened in, i.e. Denmark, Russia

params.name: region
params.description: Filter by full name of region messages were opened in, i.e. Moscow, New York

params.name: city
params.description: Filter by full name of region messages were opened in, i.e. Moscow, New York
